rv.q: Jack Godfrey and Ellie Coote’s unlikely show Hot Mess deftly explores the toxic relationship between humanity and the Earth in all its ice-cap-melting glory.
A hot, sexy and unexpectedly poignant musical that feels both entertaining and urgently relevant.

cn.t: Critics praise this clever climate change rom-com for its inventive premise of Earth and Humanity's doomed love story, with strong performances and sharp direction making for a scorching, timely musical.
